g.text: CodeQuery System Architecture — Conceptual UML Class Diagram
Module Responsibilities, Attributes, and Operations mapped to CodeQuery Implementation (FastAPI, Python AST, FastEmbed, ChromaDB, Ollama)
remove_readonly(func: Callable, path: str, exc_info) : void
• Clones shallow repo (depth=1) & manages cached checkouts
• AST traversal: classes, functions, calls & import graphs
• Coordinates question embedding, ChromaDB search & LLM answer
• Splits classes & functions along line boundaries
• Avoids duplicating parent class code in method chunks
add_code_chunks(ids, embs, codes, metas, batch=500) : void
• Persistent on-disk vector index with metadata filtering
